title: Row–column symmetry and contraction of coordinate sweeps
summary: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`N=2^d`$ labeled cards has full-permutation total-variation mixing time $`\Theta(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles. An absolute number of coordinate sweeps suffices for the upper bound.
family_title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

review.reason: Proves Theta(log N) total-variation mixing time for the Thorp shuffle on labeled cards.
